lead_raw_text:
The structure of Ce4Mg2Cu12 (reduced formula Ce2MgCu6) crystallizes in the monoclinic space group C2/m (No. 119), with 18 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies close-packed-like local arrangements for all three elements: Ce and Mg centers each have 12 geometric neighbors, while Cu centers have 12 neighbors. The periodic neighbor graph is fully connected in three dimensions, and validated polyhedron contacts show corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Cu 12-vertex polyhedra, plus corner- and edge-sharing between Ce and Cu polyhedra.
